description: Check live safety conditions at a coordinate on US public land: active wildfire perimeters and distance to the nearest fire, river and streamflow level against seasonal normals, advisory-grade weather in the next 7 days, open park closures and hazard alerts, and air quality. Returns a 0-100 Trip Safety Score. Call this whenever someone asks whether a place is safe to visit, whether a fire or smoke is affecting it, whether a trail or road is closed, or whether a river is runnable. It reports what was CHECKED and what is unknown separately, so absence of a warning is never presented as an all-clear.
name: check_conditions
title: Live safety conditions for a place
